description: Search for domain names: checks with the domain registry which names are available to register, across popular endings (.com, .co, .net, .org, .io, .app by default), and adds available ideas suggested by the registry. Pass the user's words in query (a business name, an idea, or a full domain) and/or your own name ideas in names (e.g. ["harborgrind", "harborgrindcoffee", "drinkharbor.com"]); up to 24 names are checked per search. When GearHost domain registration is open, available names include the yearly price GearHost charges and a buy_url where the user completes the purchase in their GearHost account; no purchase happens through this tool. Status "unknown" means the registry did not answer for that name, not that it is free. No sign-in needed.

names.description: Optional name ideas to check, with or without an ending (e.g. "harborgrind" or "harborgrind.co"). Names without an ending are tried on every ending in tlds.

query.description: The user's words: a business or project name ("Harbor Grind coffee"), or a full domain to check ("harborgrind.com").

tlds.description: Optional endings to try, e.g. ["com","shop","cafe"]. Default: com, co, net, org, io, app.

years.description: Registration length for prices, in years (default 1).

name: search_domains

premium.description: A registry premium name, priced individually (usually higher).

source.description: requested (named by you or the user), variation (a name on another ending) or registry_suggestion.

selling.description: true when domains can be bought at GearHost right now (prices and buy_url are included).

title: Search domain names
